code: import axios from'axios';const api=axios.create({baseURL:'http://localhost:5001/api'});api.interceptors.request.use(config=>{const token=localStorage.getItem('token');if(token){config.headers.Authorization="Bearer ".concat(token);}return config;},error=>Promise.reject(error));api.interceptors.response.use(response=>response,error=>{if(error.response&&error.response.status===401){localStorage.removeItem('token');localStorage.removeItem('user');if(window.location.pathname!=='/login'){window.location.href='/login';}}return Promise.reject(error);});export default api;
